A buyer's full account or billing data is not supplied to every Creator by default. Information shared to resolve a specific issue must not be reused by the Creator for unsolicited marketing.

sections.title: 6. International processing

The exact recipient, destination countries, categories, purpose, timing or method, retention, and available choices are set out in the transfer schedule in the Privacy Policy. We use a lawful transfer mechanism where required, such as a recognized adequacy arrangement or appropriate contractual safeguards, and assess the actual transfer rather than assuming a provider's brand is enough.

Contract-necessary processing and optional processing must be distinguished under the applicable basis. Where a consent is required, declining it must have the accurately stated consequence; it cannot authorize unrelated transfers. Contact us for relevant safeguards or questions about a recipient.

sections.title: 7. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: We retain each category only for the stated purpose and applicable legal requirements. The following is our retention schedule, subject to the provider schedule in the Privacy Policy and a specific, documented legal or security hold:
Category Retention approach

Active account, workspace and source — While the account or workspace is used and needed to provide the service. Verified deletion requests have an operational target of completion within 30 days, except for records that must remain for legal, accounting, payment, fraud, security or dispute obligations. Requests are handled through the Privacy Requests process; Webcanbe does not claim that account deletion is automatic, and provider-managed deletion or backup lifecycles may continue for the periods disclosed below.

Recoverable backups — Webcanbe does not currently operate a separate managed backup store, and the current Supabase Free plan does not include automatic daily database backups. If Webcanbe-managed backup copies are introduced, their deletion or overwrite target is 30 days. Provider-managed disaster-recovery copies follow the provider's verified lifecycle; for example, Firebase states that deleted Authentication data is removed from live and backup systems within 180 days. A specifically documented lawful hold may require longer retention; backups are not used to reactivate deleted accounts for ordinary purposes.

Routine raw security and diagnostic logs — The application does not maintain a general durable store of raw diagnostic logs. Any ordinary Webcanbe-controlled transient security or audit log that is retained has a 180-day target, with longer retention only for an active incident, fraud investigation, dispute or legal obligation. Relevant incident records are isolated and reviewed instead of retaining all raw logs indefinitely. Immutable control, release, publication, rights, payment, license and entitlement evidence is not treated as an ordinary raw log and remains with the underlying provenance or transaction record.

Contracts, payment and supply records — Keep the minimum records for the applicable statutory period. Where Korean electronic-commerce record rules apply, contract/cancellation and payment/supply records are generally retained for five years.
Consumer complaints and disputes — Where Korean electronic-commerce record rules apply, generally three years; retain a particular unresolved claim longer only on a documented legal basis.
Advertising records Where the corresponding Korean record rule applies, generally six months.
License and rights evidence Keep the minimum release, license, order, and rights evidence needed for outstanding licenses or claims, separating it from unnecessary profile and source data.

AI request results — The current implementation does not persist raw AI prompt text or transient selected-source input context after the request completes, which is shorter than the 30-day maximum target for any future Webcanbe-controlled temporary copy. Accepted project edits and revisions remain ordinary project data, while AI usage, reservation and outcome metadata remains account or transaction data. Cloudflare Workers AI does not store request content unless a separate storage service is deliberately used and does not use Customer Content for training or service improvement without explicit consent.

When a backup is restored for recovery, deletion instructions must be reapplied before it becomes an ordinary live data source. Deleting a Creator account does not require deletion of the minimum release and license evidence needed to honor buyers' existing lawful rights. We do not keep an entire private workspace merely because one order record must be retained.

sections.title: 8. Your rights and choices
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, a copy or portability, restriction, objection to certain processing, withdrawal of consent, and review of qualifying automated decisions. You may also complain to the competent privacy regulator, including your local supervisory authority where applicable. We do not condition a right on giving up another mandatory right.

Use Privacy Requests or hello@webcanbe.com. We verify identity proportionately and may need limited information to locate the records. We do not normally need your password or a full identity-document scan. Where an organization controls project data, we may forward or direct a request to that organization while assisting as required.

We respond within the applicable legal period. GDPR requests generally require a response within one month, with a permitted extension explained within that first month; a shorter local deadline takes priority. A deletion request may leave limited legally required records, which we will identify by category and reason.

paragraphs: Appendix A below explains essential authentication and preference storage and any optional technologies. Non-essential analytics, marketing, or third-party embeds must not be loaded before required consent. Refusing them does not prevent core account use. Service, security, and transaction communications are separate from optional marketing messages.

The service is not directed to children under 13. Higher local minimum-age or parental- consent requirements may apply. Where a lawful representative arrangement is required, it must be established before collecting information under that arrangement. If we learn that an account was created without legally required authorization, we will take proportionate steps to restrict processing and handle the information lawfully.

sections.title: 10. Security and changes
paragraphs: We use measures appropriate to the service, including encrypted transport, access controls, authenticated server-side authorization, and limits on secret exposure. No promise of absolute security, end-to-end encryption of all source, zero data retention, or independent certification is made here unless separately and accurately documented.

Material changes to purposes, recipients, or choices will be explained before they take effect where required, with fresh consent where necessary. The effective date above identifies this version. Contact Webcanbe Privacy Contact at hello@webcanbe.com for questions.

sections.title: 11. PostHog analytics and session replay
paragraphs: If enabled after a verified Webcanbe project token and host are configured, PostHog will provide optional product analytics to understand visits, broad country-level location, referral sources and whether people complete relevant actions, such as creating an account, starting a project, saving an edit, returning to a project, exporting source or completing an enabled purchase. Analytics can include a pseudonymous visitor or account identifier, timestamps, permitted route and campaign labels, browser or device category, event names and limited event properties. These are not necessarily anonymous merely because a direct name is omitted.

We do not intentionally send private project source, AI prompt text, access credentials, full support messages, payment-card data or identity-verification documents to product analytics. Public-page URLs and referrers are reduced or filtered to avoid query-string secrets and unnecessary identifiers. Location is approximate rather than GPS-level location. IP addresses can be processed in the connection and country-lookup process; the actual storage and disposal rule is in Appendix B. Refusing optional analytics does not prevent the essential account, licensed editing or payment functions.

PostHog is disabled in the current launch configuration, and session replay is disabled in code. If replay is later offered, we will update this notice and provide any required prior choice before capture begins. That feature can reconstruct on-site interactions; it is not permission to record a user's entire device. Private source editors, project previews containing private content, authentication, payment credentials, identity records and sensitive support fields must be excluded or masked before transmission. General input masking alone is not treated as protection for code displayed as page text.

We do not use analytics identifiers for third-party cross-context behavioral advertising or sell access to individual usage profiles. Campaign results shared with prospective Creators use aggregate figures, not identifiable participant or customer records. Cookie and other storage choices are described in Appendix A; the active PostHog region, recipient, retention and rights-handling configuration are disclosed in Appendix B.

sections.title: 12. Build League, referrals and showcase information
paragraphs: If you voluntarily enter a campaign, we process your account reference, public handle, submitted post and project URLs, entry time, qualifying product events, permitted referral attribution and selection or claim records. Where analytics consent is required, we do not bypass that choice by relabeling optional audience tracking as eligibility verification. Essential campaign evidence is kept separately from optional analytics.

For a domain award, the selected participant may need a registrar account reference, eligible contact information and a transfer acceptance. We do not ask for a registrar password or payment to release an advertised free prize.

Only the public entry information described before submission is displayed in a leaderboard or gallery. Contact details, identity evidence and private source are not public entry fields. Additional use in advertisements, testimonials or winner publicity requires the applicable

separate permission; declining unrelated publicity does not forfeit a valid reward. Entry administration messages are distinct from optional marketing subscriptions. Campaign records follow this schedule: No optional PostHog analytics or durable campaign-attribution store is enabled in the current production configuration. If ordinary campaign or referral attribution data is collected for a published campaign, its retention target is 90 days unless a longer period is required for a specific legal or accounting purpose. Reward eligibility, claim, fraud-prevention and financial records are separate records and may be kept for their applicable obligation, including a documented dispute or legal-record requirement.

sections.title: 13. Choices that do not require losing your account
paragraphs: You may decline optional analytics, leave a promotion, unsubscribe from marketing or remove an optional public showcase without asking to delete all of your projects. Changes operate prospectively; we may retain limited evidence of a completed transaction, a concluded promotion or a legal claim where justified. We will explain any effect on an entry still awaiting selection. A privacy request is not treated as fraud or breach simply because it makes analytics less complete.

sections.title: 14. Information processed for a business customer
paragraphs: Where we process personal information in an organization's private project solely on that organization's instructions, a separate data-processing agreement is needed when applicable law requires it. That agreement must identify the parties, instructions, data categories, approved providers, safeguards, assistance, incident notification and return or deletion arrangements. We do not treat these general policies as a signed DPA, executed Standard Contractual Clauses or evidence of a particular data-residency configuration. Ask hello@webcanbe.com about the arrangement before uploading regulated or specially sensitive datasets into a workspace.

sections.title: Appendix A. Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: A.1 Why storage is used Webcanbe uses browser storage and similar technologies to authenticate a session, complete a sign-in flow, retain necessary navigation state, support secure requests, and remember interface choices. These technologies must be classified by actual purpose rather than calling all scripts “essential.”

The production architecture includes secure first-party session and short-lived sign-in state cookies. Firebase authentication may use its own SDK persistence according to the chosen configuration. A local interface preference or draft-recovery entry may use session storage, local storage, or another browser store. The current names, purposes, lifetimes, providers, and storage types are listed in Appendix C below. The inventory is part of this policy and is updated when the enabled product changes.

A.2 Essential and optional technologies Strictly necessary authentication, security, and requested-function storage is used for those purposes. Optional analytics, advertising, cross-site tracking, and third-party media with non- essential storage require consent where applicable. We do not classify an advertising pixel as necessary merely because it helps our business.

The absence of optional trackers may mean no general consent banner is necessary for a particular deployment. That does not remove the need for this notice or for consent if an optional technology is later added. A preference that is essential in one context is not automatically essential in all contexts.

A.3 Video and external embeds When an external video is embedded, we provide a local preview until you choose to load that media and give any required consent. The provider and its receipt of connection data are identified before loading. Written documentation remains available if you decline the video.

A.4 Your choices Where optional technologies are present, you can accept or reject them without a preselected choice and later change the choice through the Privacy choices control at the Privacy Policy and Privacy Requests pages, or hello@webcanbe.com; no optional analytics control is shown while optional analytics is disabled. Rejection should be as accessible as acceptance. Essential account functions remain available, although blocking all cookies or local storage through browser settings may prevent authentication or local recovery.

Deleting browser storage can remove preferences or unsynced drafts. Sign out and export important work where appropriate before clearing storage. Server-side account deletion is separate from clearing cookies.

A.5 Referrals and tracking signals We may use an ordinary incoming campaign or referrer indicator to understand how a public page was found where lawful and disclosed. It does not change the content shown to a search bot versus a human. A referral parameter does not authorize device fingerprinting, disclosure of an account to an external AI provider, or creation of an unrelated advertising profile without an appropriate basis.

Where applicable privacy law requires honoring a recognized opt-out signal, we implement it for the covered processing. Do not infer that a “Do Not Track” setting has a universal technical effect across all providers. Contact hello@webcanbe.com for the current inventory or a privacy question.

sections.title: Appendix B. Providers and international processing
paragraphs: This schedule describes each enabled recipient and its particular role. “Processor” means a provider processing on our instructions for that function; some providers separately determine how to process information for their own account, fraud-prevention or legal duties. Webcanbe does not authorize general-purpose training on private source or prompts through ordinary use. This does not promise that Webcanbe's own accepted source history, request outcomes, logs or backup records are never stored.

Optional deployment services receive project artifacts only when that specific feature is requested. Support is handled through hello@webcanbe.com. A requested future deployment or email provider must be disclosed here before that function is enabled.

These particulars are supplied before transfer where required. A recognized adequacy arrangement or valid contractual safeguard is used only where it actually covers the recipient and transfer. sections.title: Appendix C. Storage and analytics inventory
paragraphs: The inventory below must match the version of Webcanbe you use. Core session and requested draft-recovery functions are distinguished from optional analytics; data is not classified as essential solely because it is commercially useful to us.

Clearing local storage can remove unsynced drafts or require sign-in again; it is different from a server-side deletion request. A browser opt-out signal is honored for processing to which the applicable law gives that signal effect; this is not a representation that every browser “Do Not Track” setting controls every external service.

sections.title: 5. Review and publication
paragraphs: Seller acceptance and project acceptance are separate. We may reject or request changes for incomplete functionality, unsupported required dependencies, rights issues, safety concerns, or misleading claims. We provide an intelligible reason and a way to resubmit or seek review.

Compatibility and Ready qualifications attach to a specific release and its test evidence, not to all future work by a Creator. You cannot purchase or self-assign those labels. Review is not a guarantee of freedom from every vulnerability or legal issue and does not eliminate your warranties about source rights and disclosed functionality.

Free releases use the same core quality and safety review. A later decision to charge for a listing does not revoke licenses lawfully obtained for an earlier free release. Submission limits displayed in Creator Studio are operational controls; changes cannot retrospectively cancel existing licenses or accrued valid earnings.

sections.title: 6. Prices, discounts, and fees
paragraphs: You may offer a free listing or choose a paid list price of at least USD 9. There is no general maximum price. Material price errors or deceptive pricing may be rejected. A discount and who funds it must be clear. Creator-funded discounts reduce the item-price fee base; Webcanbe-funded incentives do not silently reduce the Creator's agreed proceeds.

The standard platform fee is 5% during the first three calendar months after the public paid- marketplace launch, and 8% thereafter. The launch timestamp used for this calculation is disclosed in Creator Studio and the applicable fee schedule. It is not restarted per Creator. The fee base is the actual post-discount item price, excluding separately collected taxes. Published fee calculations use whole minor currency units and the documented rounding rule consistently; they do not round an amount differently merely to increase the fee.

The first 100 Creators expressly accepted into the Founding Creator offer receive a 0% platform fee until the earlier of 12 months from their first paid listing going live or USD 100,000 cumulative gross paid sales. Actual payment and payout processing costs remain separate. The offer is a platform-fee discount, not a guarantee of sales, marketing placement, free payment processing, or a cash reward. Eligibility must be recorded; a marketing badge alone does not establish it. The fee rate recorded when an order is accepted applies to that order. Under this offer, an order accepted before the sales cap is reached keeps that rate; the normal rate applies prospectively to later orders. The offer does not retroactively increase fees on earlier orders.

Third-party payment and payout costs are passed through only at actual attributable cost, without an undisclosed markup. The earnings statement separates item amount, tax, platform fee, actual processor costs, adjustments, and net payable. No extra buyer-facing Webcanbe service fee or Creator application/listing fee is imposed unless separately disclosed and accepted prospectively. Webcanbe subscription and AI-pack revenue is not Creator project-sale revenue.

sections.title: 7. Holds and payouts
paragraphs: Ordinary earnings are held for 14 days after confirmed payment, then become eligible subject to reversals and verification. Payout batches are scheduled on the 1st and 15th of the month using Korea Standard Time, UTC+9. The ordinary minimum is USD 25 in available net payable earnings. Amounts below the minimum carry forward; they are not forfeited merely because the threshold was not reached.

Initial payout execution may be manual. An approval click is not proof of payment; a paid status requires an actual provider reference and reconciliation. Provider processing or banking delays can affect arrival. Creator Studio must distinguish pending, held, available, sent, paid/reconciled, and failed amounts where applicable, rather than treating all sales as immediately withdrawable cash.

We may extend a hold for a specific dispute, refund exposure, suspected fraud, identity mismatch, or legal requirement. The scope and amount will reasonably match the documented risk. We will give a reason and review route where lawful and review continuing holds rather than retain all earnings indefinitely without justification. On closure, lawful net earnings remain payable, including a practical final settlement process for amounts below USD 25 subject to actual transfer costs and provider constraints.

sections.title: 8. Refunds, disputes, and losses
paragraphs: The common Refund Policy applies; Creators cannot replace it with a stricter private policy that removes promised or mandatory buyer rights. Provide relevant support and evidence promptly when notified of an issue. Webcanbe remains the buyer-facing contact for its order obligations and may issue a justified refund without waiting indefinitely for Creator consent.

For a Creator-attributable failure, corresponding earnings may be reversed before payout. After payout, a documented adjustment may create a negative balance offset against future earnings or an amount legitimately due. We will identify the affected order, reason, provider costs, and calculation. Loss caused by Webcanbe's payment integration failure or misconduct is not automatically charged to an innocent Creator. A buyer's lawful dispute is not evidence of buyer fraud by itself.

We must not recover the same loss twice, apply an arbitrary penalty, or retroactively alter a fee to cover our unrelated costs. Partial refunds and tax adjustments must use an auditable, proportionate allocation. You may challenge an adjustment through Creator Support; undisputed amounts should not be withheld without an independent reason.

sections.title: 9. Taxes and records
paragraphs: Each party is responsible for taxes imposed on its own income and any tax duties assigned to it by applicable law. Webcanbe is responsible for the buyer-tax collection, invoicing, remittance, and platform reporting obligations that applicable law places on it as the contracting distributor. The Creator remains responsible for its own income and supplier-side tax obligations. Neither party may allocate a statutory duty away merely by describing the other as a supplier. Using PayPal does not, by itself, transfer those duties to PayPal. Required withholding or reporting must be disclosed and supported by appropriate documentation.

We may retain minimum transaction and license records needed to honor buyer rights and meet law. Access to full buyer personal information is not granted merely because you made a sale. Use any support information you receive only for that request, not unsolicited marketing.

sections.title: 10. Support, updates, and withdrawal
paragraphs: Honor the support and update scope stated when the buyer acquired the release. There is no default promise of lifetime updates, custom implementation, or unlimited support. A necessary remedy for a misleading or defective release cannot be avoided by declaring that all support was optional.

You may ask to stop future distribution. Delisting does not cancel existing buyer licenses, completed orders, earned sums, or support already promised. Tell us promptly of an infringement claim, dangerous defect, compromised dependency, or leaked credential. We may quarantine affected downloads and inform buyers while preserving unrelated lawful work and providing appropriate remedies.

sections.title: 11. Claims and responsibility
paragraphs: To the extent lawful for this professional supply relationship, you will reimburse reasonable direct losses and third-party claim costs attributable to your material breach of source-rights warranties, deliberate unlawful content, or intentional deception. This obligation does not cover losses caused by Webcanbe's own negligence or unauthorized alterations. We must give prompt notice, reasonable evidence, and an opportunity to participate in the defense; no settlement imposing admissions or non-monetary duties on you without your reasonable consent.

Our applicable liability terms do not eliminate payment obligations or mandatory remedies. Suspension and termination must be proportionate to the problem. Informal dispute review is available through hello@webcanbe.com and does not remove access to competent courts or statutory rights.

sections.title: 12. Changes, duration and records
paragraphs: This agreement continues while we distribute your approved releases or perform outstanding obligations under it. Either party may end future distribution through the stated delisting or closure process. Existing buyer rights, accrued earnings, justified adjustments, confidentiality, minimum record duties and terms needed to resolve existing claims survive only for their relevant purposes.

A material adverse change to future fees or this agreement is notified prospectively, ordinarily at least 30 days before it applies or longer where law requires. It does not reprice an accepted order or cut short a recorded Founding Creator benefit contrary to its accepted conditions. Necessary urgent legal or security changes may require a shorter interval with an explanation. You may stop future distribution rather than accept an applicable new arrangement, without forfeiting lawful accrued earnings.

Your acceptance record identifies the actual Creator, representative authority where relevant, agreement version, applicable fee schedule and accepted releases. Electronic confirmation and payout statements are retained in a form you can keep. Questions and requests for a calculation review can be sent to hello@webcanbe.com.

sections.title: Appendix A. Marketplace submission and release standards
paragraphs: A.1 A release must be a real deliverable A listing must identify what is actually supplied: source files, dependencies, install/build instructions, assets, applicable license, supported editing/preview modes, and any external service needed. A polished screenshot is not proof that the project runs. A backend- dependent demo must disclose that dependency rather than promise a self-contained application.

Paid and free projects follow the same core standards for safety, rights, and accurate descriptions. Free content is not exempt from review, and payment does not purchase a Ready badge. We may apply disclosed submission and publication limits to prevent spam without charging a hidden upload fee.

A.2 Rights and provenance Keep evidence of authorship or redistribution permission for source and assets. A resource that is free to download or allowed for one client's website is not automatically allowed for redistribution in a template marketplace or website builder. Preserve third-party license and attribution files. Fonts, photos, icons, sample logos, and code can have different rights.

A release must include a license manifest identifying material restrictions and separately obtained assets. Do not remove MIT or Apache notices or claim those components are proprietary. Where a whole release is open source, describe that license truthfully; a buyer may be paying for curation or service rather than exclusive code rights.

A.3 Review, compatibility, and Ready We review the submitted release and any material replacement, not an indefinitely changing external repository. A compatibility record should distinguish runtime execution, Visual editability, source mapping, export build, hosted readiness, and test environment. Describe unsupported or partially supported cases clearly.

A snapshot preview can prove rendered appearance and source observations without proving live user interaction. An independent export build is different from successfully creating a ZIP. A recorded deployment intent is different from an active deployed URL. “Verified,” “Ready,” or similar claims must state the release and meaningful scope of evidence.

A.4 Price, support, and updates Free listings are allowed. The ordinary minimum paid list price is USD 9, without a general maximum. Pricing, discounts, taxes where applicable, and required third-party charges must be clear before payment. No fabricated crossed-out price or urgency is allowed.

State the included support and update terms. A listing does not promise lifetime support by default. However, statutory remedies and the common issue-refund policy cannot be removed by writing “no support” after a sale. A new release may be separately priced only if earlier update promises are honored.

A.5 Changes, delisting, and existing buyers A published release is immutable; edits to a buyer's working copy do not alter that release. Source updates require the supported new-release process, and material changes may require review. A Creator may correct public metadata without misleading buyers about what they purchased.

Changing a listing from free to paid, delisting it, or leaving Webcanbe does not revoke valid rights already granted. Serious rights or security problems may require limiting future downloads and notifying affected buyers, with appropriate remedies. Keep order and license evidence tied to the exact release.

A.6 Authentic presentation Use real project screenshots and clearly described demonstrations. Do not publish invented customer testimonials as genuine endorsements, fabricate usage or revenue numbers, or claim external company partnerships without evidence. A fictional persona can illustrate a use case only when the presentation does not mislead a reasonable visitor into believing it is a real customer's experience.

A private design preview containing invented testimonial copy must not be promoted to public marketing unchanged. Keep the layout and replace the content with documented reviews or plainly editorial product/use-case statements.

A.7 Reporting and appeal Use hello@webcanbe.com or the relevant reporting page for a non-working release, misleading listing, rights issue, or suspected malicious source. Give the listing and release reference and a concise explanation; do not include secrets. We assess the report, preserve relevant evidence, and may contact the Creator. Creators may seek review of a rejection or adjustment. Mandatory reporting and consumer remedies remain available.

sections.title: 1. Three different purchases
paragraphs: A marketplace project license, a Webcanbe subscription, and a purchased AI Action pack are separate products. Cancelling a subscription does not automatically refund a project or invalidate its license. A refund to one order is not automatically a refund to every order on an account.

This policy includes a voluntary issue-based remedy and preserves mandatory rights. A seven-day request window below does not shorten a statutory withdrawal, conformity, fraud, or payment-dispute right. The law that protects you may require a different remedy or timing. A provider's claim process is also separate from our voluntary policy.

sections.title: 2. Digital project purchases
paragraphs: We do not offer a general change-of-mind guarantee for digital project purchases. Please review the specific release, compatibility, preview limitations, required external services, and license before buying.

For our voluntary project-issue policy, contact us within seven calendar days of purchase where the listing was materially misleading, delivery failed or the files cannot be accessed, the represented essential functionality materially fails, the purchase was duplicated, or a verified Webcanbe failure prevents the normal promised use. Describe the issue and include your order reference. We will assess the actual release and disclosed requirements, not an unrelated example project.

A reasonable repair or replacement may resolve a defect where lawful and appropriate. We will not force an endless repair process, unreasonable work, or acceptance of materially different content in place of an applicable refund. Serious fraud, concealed rights problems, and mandatory legal claims remain reviewable after seven days.

A preference for another design, lack of a separate third-party service that was clearly disclosed, or an unsupported modification is not itself a covered original-product defect. Those exclusions do not apply when the relevant limitation was hidden or our own claim was misleading.

sections.title: 3. Subscriptions
paragraphs: Cancelling stops future renewal according to the cancellation confirmation. Unless you choose a separately explained immediate termination or a lawful suspension applies, paid plan access continues until the paid-through date. No new renewal should be initiated after a valid cancellation takes effect. Service behavior and receipts must honor this rule.

Outside mandatory rights, we do not offer an automatic prorated refund simply because you stop using a functioning subscription mid-period. Contact us for duplicate or unauthorized billing, a charge after timely cancellation, failure to provide the purchased plan, or a material service failure. We will correct billing errors and provide the remedy required by law or the service we actually failed to supply. This subsection is not limited to the project's seven-day voluntary window.

Annual billing pays for the stated annual period. Monthly AI grants within that annual service do not convert it into twelve unrelated project purchases, and cancellation does not erase a statutory withdrawal right that still exists.

sections.title: 4. AI Action packs and AI request failures
paragraphs: Purchased Actions do not expire merely with a calendar month or subscription change. A successfully generated, validated, reviewable proposal is the billable result described before requesting it; applying the same accepted proposal does not create a second charge. Declining a valid proposal because you prefer a different result is not automatically a failed generation.

If the provider, network, or validation fails before delivery of a usable result, the service must release or correct the associated reservation. If source was already accepted but recording the outcome fails, we preserve and reconcile the original charge and result without charging or applying twice. A browser cancellation or disconnected response alone does not prove what the server completed; contact us with the request reference when its status remains uncertain.

We will correct duplicate charges, undelivered packs, and missing balances. Outside mandatory rights, packs are not freely redeemable for cash or refunded solely for a change of mind. If we permanently discontinue the service needed to use valid paid Actions, we will provide a fair remedy for the unused paid portion, ordinarily a proportional refund based on its actual purchase price, subject to mandatory law. We do not apply an invented cash value to free promotional Actions.

sections.title: 5. Statutory digital-content withdrawal
paragraphs: Consumers in some regions, including the EU/EEA and UK, may have a statutory period to withdraw from a distance contract. The ordinary period for applicable service or electronically supplied digital-content contracts is generally 14 days from conclusion, subject to the local rules and required disclosures.

For downloadable digital content, loss of a withdrawal right is not caused by a hidden Terms clause alone. Where the law permits immediate supply with loss of withdrawal, we must obtain the required prior express consent and acknowledgement, begin supply accordingly, and give the required contract confirmation. Defect and misdescription rights are not waived by that consent.

For an ongoing service, requesting an early start is different from receiving a complete download. Where lawful, withdrawal may require payment only for properly requested service actually supplied; full loss of the service withdrawal right requires the applicable conditions. We do not use a digital-download waiver indiscriminately for every subscription or Action pack.

If you decline immediate digital supply, we must either offer lawful delayed delivery or refrain from presenting an incompatible immediate-delivery checkout to you. We do not treat a mandatory consent choice as an optional decoration and then supply the same content regardless.

You may notify us at hello@webcanbe.com or use the withdrawal function provided for eligible orders. In territories where an online withdrawal function is required, it must remain accessible during the relevant period and provide a durable acknowledgement. An account login must not prevent a customer who has lost access from sending a valid notice.

sections.title: 6. Submitting and handling a request
paragraphs: Provide your contact email, order or subscription reference if available, product, and the requested remedy. For a technical defect, a short description or redacted screenshot is useful. A statutory withdrawal notice does not require a defect explanation, a video, or a particular form. We will not require passwords, complete card numbers, or secrets to investigate.

We will acknowledge and decide requests within the applicable deadline and explain the outcome. Where a refund is due, it is normally returned by the original payment method. We do not force store credit instead of a money refund required by law. Provider settlement time can affect when the refund appears, but we remain responsible for initiating it within the applicable deadline.

A reversal may update license, entitlement, and Creator earnings records. A completed rescission of a project purchase ordinarily ends the refunded license as explained in the Buyer License. Do not keep distributing refunded proprietary materials. We do not claim your unrelated original content, and an open dispute alone is not an automatic deletion instruction.

sections.title: 8. Project issues, account deletion and promotions
paragraphs: Deleting an account is not a substitute for cancelling a recurring plan, and cancelling a plan does not request deletion of all data. If you ask us to close an account with an active subscription, we will explain and coordinate the billing consequence rather than knowingly continue charging an unusable account. Privacy requests remain available separately.

A campaign entry, free promotional Action grant or domain prize is governed by the relevant campaign's accepted rules. Promotional units do not carry an invented cash redemption value. These distinctions do not excuse failure to deliver an earned promised reward or remove a remedy required by law.

sections.title: 1. Scope
paragraphs: This policy applies to public listings, private workspaces, AI requests, previews, exported materials to the extent our licenses govern them, and interactions with the service. A lawful technical topic or unfamiliar implementation is not automatically abuse; restrictions depend on actual conduct, permissions, content rights, and applicable law.

sections.title: 2. Prohibited conduct
paragraphs: Do not upload or distribute material you are not entitled to use; impersonate another person or business; use stolen payment credentials; misrepresent source authorship or rights; or publish unlawful personal information. Do not distribute malware, credential theft, hidden malicious dependencies, unauthorized surveillance, or code intentionally designed to compromise others through our marketplace.

Do not bypass another user's authorization, exploit leaked secrets, evade transaction or usage controls, generate sham purchases or payouts, manipulate reviews or qualification evidence, or interfere with the service's availability. Testing your own project is different from attacking a provider's infrastructure or another customer's workspace. Security research should follow the Security Reporting Policy.

Do not submit illegal exploitation content, threats, criminal harassment, or products whose sale would violate applicable law or the approved payment-provider scope. We do not approve a regulated business merely because its website template can be edited. Project instructions and model responses do not authorize access to secrets, privileged tools, or financial operations.

sections.title: 3. Fair resource use
paragraphs: Respect the limits disclosed for your plan and permitted automation. Do not hide automated abuse behind multiple accounts or overload isolated build and preview systems. We may use proportionate rate limits and ask for a legitimate-use explanation; legitimate automation or high volume is not by itself proof of malicious conduct.

sections.title: 4. Public claims and feedback
paragraphs: Listings and marketing must accurately describe the release, supported features, third-party costs, and included license. Do not fabricate customers, reviews, transactions, screenshots presented as live results, or badges. Material incentives or relationships behind testimonials must be disclosed where required. Honest negative feedback and good-faith complaints are allowed; these terms contain no penalty or gag clause for them.

sections.title: 5. Enforcement and review
paragraphs: We may remove or quarantine affected material, restrict the relevant function, request information, or suspend an account where warranted. We consider severity, repetition, intent where known, and the risk to others. We will provide an explanation and an opportunity for review where lawful and practicable. Immediate containment may be appropriate for ongoing malware, fraud, or serious danger.

A restriction does not automatically forfeit lawful earnings, unrelated source, or mandatory refunds. We preserve relevant evidence and provide an appropriate export or remedy path where safe. Report concerns or appeal an action through hello@webcanbe.com with the relevant account, project or decision reference.

sections.title: 6. Promotions, public builds and attribution
paragraphs: Do not fabricate entry qualifications, steal another person's finished build, impersonate entrants, buy bot traffic, conceal automated duplicate accounts or create sham referrals. Verification uses the published campaign criteria and relevant evidence. We may request proportionate statistics for a shortlisted reach-based entry; an unusually successful legitimate post is not, by itself, evidence of abuse.

Describe your real experience and disclose material incentives where required. You may criticize Webcanbe honestly, compare it with other tools, report defects and seek refunds. An unfavorable opinion is not grounds to confiscate lawful earnings, remove an otherwise valid entry or terminate an unrelated project license.

Do not post another person's private data or proprietary reusable source merely to prove that a project exists. A public End Project, screenshot or redacted demonstration usually provides a way to show the work without disclosing unrelated files.

sections.title: Appendix A. Security reporting and authorized research
paragraphs: A.1 Report a vulnerability Send a report to hello@webcanbe.com with the subject “Security report.” Include the affected Webcanbe URL or component, a minimal reproduction, potential impact, and a safe way to contact you. Redact credentials and other users' information. Ask for a secure transfer channel before sending sensitive artifacts.

This is a disclosure channel, not a promise of a paid bug bounty, certification, fixed response- time guarantee, or authorization to test unrelated providers. We will assess credible reports and coordinate appropriate remediation.

A.2 Permitted good-faith research We authorize proportionate, non-destructive testing of Webcanbe-controlled public application endpoints using accounts and projects you control, provided you minimize access and stop when a vulnerability is demonstrated. Do not access, change, exfiltrate, or publish another person's private data; perform denial-of-service or high-volume scans; execute real payment or payout abuse; deploy malware; use social engineering; or attack authentication, cloud, payment, or other third-party systems.

If you encounter another user's data, stop, do not retain more than the minimum redacted evidence, and notify us. Public source availability is not permission to probe every connected production service. Contact us before tests that could cause material load or irreversible effects.

A.3 Our commitment For good-faith research that follows this policy, we will not bring a claim under our Terms solely because you tested or reported the issue. If a third party questions research that complied with this policy, we will make that limited authorization clear where appropriate. We cannot grant immunity under criminal law or waive a third party's rights.

We will evaluate reports on their evidence rather than require public exploitation. A reasonable coordinated-disclosure discussion should not be used to silence independent lawful speech indefinitely. Do not publish active secrets or personal data as part of disclosure.

A.4 User-facing security statements Our published security descriptions must accurately state the tested boundary and environment. They do not promise that code is immune to all vulnerabilities. Report incorrect security claims or a suspected account compromise through the same channel, specifying which issue requires urgent containment.

sections.title: 1. Platform code and purchased projects are different
paragraphs: The license to use the Webcanbe service, the license for a project acquired through its marketplace, and the licenses of third-party components are separate. Receiving source does not automatically transfer exclusive copyright. A platform subscription does not change a purchased project's permitted number of End Projects.

The applicable project license and release-specific notices are supplied with the order and export. The Single-Project Commercial License applies only where expressly selected for the release. A project under MIT, Apache-2.0, or another open-source license retains the permissions and conditions of that license.

sections.title: 2. Third-party notices
paragraphs: The release-specific platform component and asset notices are provided at https://webcanbe.com/legal/third-party-notices. That inventory identifies the package or asset, version where applicable, copyright owner, license, required attribution, and source or notice location. Notices are specific to the distributed package or asset and its applicable version.

Project exports must preserve their own license manifest and required notices. A top-level code license does not automatically cover every photograph, icon, font, sample logo, or bundled dataset. If an essential asset requires a separate license, that restriction must be disclosed before acquisition.

sections.title: 3. Branding and reports
paragraphs: Webcanbe branding does not grant permission to imply endorsement or resell the service under its name. Creator and third-party trademarks remain with their respective owners. Publicly available brand assets have only the permission stated with them, not a blanket trademark assignment.

Report a missing attribution or licensing concern to hello@webcanbe.com with the exact component, listing, release, or export. We will review the actual rights and correct notices or distribution where needed. A general notice does not override a component's license text; we provide required corrections when a missing or inaccurate notice is identified.

sections.title: 4. Release-specific notice records
paragraphs: For each acquired project, keep the license record and bundled third-party notices with the export. The record should identify the release, permitted End Project scope, included code and assets, applicable license identifiers or texts, required attribution and any clearly disclosed separate license needed for an essential asset. No generic footer notice overrides those terms.

Webcanbe's public brand name, a paid subscription and a project's zero price each have different meanings. None by itself grants an unrestricted right to reuse every asset, resell a template or claim exclusive ownership. Equally, a Webcanbe agreement does not take away independent rights you already hold under an open-source license.

AI model services and their applicable model terms are separate from the license of the Webcanbe application and its downloadable projects. A model name or an inference response does not settle the provenance of every generated file.

sections.title: Appendix A. Copyright and intellectual-property reports
paragraphs: A.1 Reporting a concern Send a rights report to hello@webcanbe.com with the subject “Copyright / IP report.” Identify the rightsholder or authorized representative, the work or right concerned, the exact Webcanbe URL and release if known, why the use is unauthorized, and contact details for follow-up. A signature, including an appropriate electronic signature, should identify the person making the report. Provide evidence you are entitled to act; do not include unrelated confidential material.

A formal U.S. DMCA notice should contain: (1) your physical or electronic signature; (2) identification of the copyrighted work, or a representative list where applicable; (3) identification and reasonably sufficient location information for the allegedly infringing material; (4) reasonably sufficient contact information, including address, telephone number and email if available; (5) a good-faith statement that the complained-of use is not authorized by the owner, its agent, or the law; and (6) a statement that the notice is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, that you are authorized to act for the owner of the allegedly infringed exclusive right. The designated-agent information for any applicable registered U.S. DMCA process is no registered U.S. DMCA designated agent has been verified for this launch; general intellectual-property reports are accepted at hello@webcanbe.com. Our general IP-report address remains available independently. Providing a reporting address is not a representation that a particular statutory safe harbor applies to every Webcanbe activity.

A.2 Assessment and action We may request clarification, restrict the affected listing or download, preserve relevant evidence, and notify the uploader as appropriate. We assess the actual material and license, not merely whether two pages look similar. A report is not automatically proof of infringement. We will avoid disclosing unnecessary personal information, but procedural notices may need to be shared with the affected party or lawful authorities.

We consider valid pre-existing open-source rights and permitted uses. We may remove an apparent unauthorized asset while preserving unrelated lawful work where feasible. Buyers may have remedies for an unlawfully distributed product under the Refund Policy and applicable law.

A.3 Counter-notices and review An affected uploader may provide authorization, licensing evidence, or a reason the identified material is not infringing. Where the U.S. DMCA process applies, a counter-notice must contain your physical or electronic signature; identify the removed or disabled material and where it appeared; state under penalty of perjury your good-faith belief that removal or disabling resulted from mistake or misidentification; and provide your name, address and telephone number. It must also state consent to the jurisdiction of the federal district court for your address, or, if outside the United States, a federal district where the service provider may be found, and acceptance of service of process from the notifying person or that person's agent. We provide the applicable contact and procedural instructions when a notice is received. We do not ask every international complaint to adopt a U.S. court clause unless using that statutory procedure.

For a valid applicable DMCA counter-notice, the statutory restoration process generally involves a 10–14 business-day interval after receipt unless the required court-action notification is received. That process is not a promise to restore independently unlawful, dangerous, or otherwise legitimately restricted material. Other jurisdictions may require a different procedure.

A.4 Repeat abuse and honest reports We may terminate repeat infringers where appropriate and maintain reasonable records to enforce this policy. We also address fraudulent or knowingly misleading reports. This policy does not penalize a good-faith complaint or legitimate disagreement about rights. A takedown does not establish that all withheld earnings are forfeited.

Questions about trademark, impersonation, privacy, or other rights can use the same contact route with the relevant category. Describe the specific legal or contractual concern rather than filing a copyright notice for an unrelated service dispute.

sections.title: 1. Request access, correction, or deletion
paragraphs: Contact Webcanbe Privacy Contact at hello@webcanbe.com with the subject “Privacy request,” or use the privacy form where one is provided. State the action you seek, the account email or safe account reference if known, and an email where we can reply. You do not need to cite an article of law or explain why you wish to exercise a right.

Available rights depend on applicable law and may include access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, portability, withdrawal of consent, and review of qualifying automated decisions. You may complain to the relevant supervisory authority. Closing an account, cancelling a subscription, and withdrawing a particular consent are distinct actions; tell us which you intend, and we will explain their consequences.

sections.title: 2. Verification and representatives
paragraphs: We verify the request in a proportionate way to protect against disclosure or deletion by another person. An authenticated account or a reply through an established address may be sufficient. Do not send passwords, access tokens, full card numbers, or a full identification- document scan unless a specific lawful necessity has been explained and a secure channel provided.

An authorized representative may act with suitable proof. We will not reject a valid request solely because the account is inaccessible. For project data controlled by an organization, we may need to work with that organization rather than disclose its information to an unverified individual.

sections.title: 3. What happens next
paragraphs: We acknowledge the request, identify relevant records, and respond within the applicable deadline. Where an extension is legally available, we explain it within the initial period. If a right is restricted, we explain the specific basis and review or complaint route where required.

Account deletion may leave minimum records needed for accounting, valid licenses, fraud investigation, or an unresolved legal claim. We do not retain all source merely because an invoice must be kept. Deleted data ages out of backups under the retention schedule in the Privacy Policy, and restoration procedures must reapply deletion instructions.

sections.title: 4. Safe request template
paragraphs: Request type: access / correction / deletion / portability / objection / consent withdrawal / other.
Account reference: [email or identifier]. Description of the relevant data or correction: [details]. Reply email: [address]. Representative authorization, only if applicable: [description].
A screenshot is optional and should be redacted. Never paste session headers or a project's secret files into the form.

sections.title: 5. Response time, cost and review
paragraphs: We respond without undue delay and within the deadline applicable to your request. Where the GDPR applies, the ordinary response period is one month from receipt; an extension of up to two further months is available only where its conditions are met, and we explain the extension and reasons within the initial month. A shorter applicable local deadline takes priority. We do not delay every request by applying the longest period found in any jurisdiction.

Rights requests are ordinarily free. We charge a permitted reasonable fee or refuse a request only where the applicable law allows it and we can explain the specific basis, such as a manifestly unfounded or excessive request under the relevant law. Exercising a privacy right does not itself justify worse treatment, loss of an unrelated license or a forced plan upgrade.

If we cannot grant all or part of a request, we explain the relevant reason and available review or complaint route. You may contact the relevant privacy regulator, including the Personal Information Protection Commission in Korea or the competent EU/UK authority where applicable. Internal review is not a prerequisite to a statutory complaint or court remedy.

sections.title: 6. Analytics, public content and deletion outcomes
paragraphs: For PostHog analytics, give the account or browser reference available to you; we do not require you to discover an internal analytics ID yourself. We will identify matching records where reasonably possible, apply the relevant deletion or objection instruction and distinguish truly non-identifiable aggregates from pseudonymous data that can still be linked to you.

Removing a public gallery entry does not automatically delete an independently posted social-media video or a domain registration record held by its registrar. We can remove material under our control and explain which independent provider to contact. Campaign evidence, financial records and license records are retained only to the extent justified, not as a reason to keep every private source file.

For account deletion, we explain the effect on workspaces, subscriptions, pending Creator payouts, accepted project licenses and unfinished prize claims. We distinguish records deleted, restricted or retained and state their purposes and retention basis. Private source, tax records and minimum license evidence are not treated as a single inseparable category.

sections.title: 7. Choosing the request you actually need
paragraphs: Stop emails: unsubscribe from optional marketing; essential account and order messages may still be necessary.
Stop analytics: use Privacy choices or contact us; this need not close the account.
Stop a subscription: cancel renewal through Billing or request assistance; project-use licenses remain separate.
Remove a public build: identify the gallery or post URL under Webcanbe's control.
Close and delete the account: state that explicitly so billing, data, team access and any remaining earnings can be coordinated.

Obtain your data: request access or portability and describe the relevant account or workspace. An ordinary source export and a full privacy access request are different; you do not need to purchase a plan upgrade merely to exercise an applicable statutory right.
